metadata.description: A marketplace for GRU953-Studio: a Tier-sized team of specialised autonomous AI software developers, led by an AI project lead, that turns a plain-English idea and a short pop-up interview into a working, tested, privately-published app. Supports Cursor, Windsurf, Devin, and all major 2026 platforms.

plugins.name: gru953-studio
plugins.description: An AI project lead plus a Tier-sized team (Tiny/Standard/Complex) of up to 38 specialised roles that interviews you by pop-up multiple-choice questions (Semi-Structured + Panel + STAR), then researches, designs, plans, codes, reviews, tests and privately publishes a working app to your own GitHub — under your name, as sole author. Built for non-technical users, in plain UK English. A native Claude Code plugin. For other AI coding tools — Cursor, Cline, Windsurf, GitHub Copilot and anything reading an AGENTS.md — it writes that tool's own instructions file, so the same working rules follow you across editors. Those file conventions change often; support is best-effort and checked per release.
